class_name: 推量-高確実性-ニホカナラナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

glosses: is nothing but; is none other than
patterns.usage_note: Not a guess but an assertion of identity: it strips away alternatives and declares what something really is, typically to reframe a thing as its true essence or to pin down a single cause. It makes no conjecture at all, and it predicates on a noun or a nominalized clause rather than attaching to verbs and adjectives directly the way the ニチガイナイ patterns do. Against those siblings the selection rule is simple: に違いない answers "is this true?", while にほかならない answers "what is this really?", so it is unusable where the speaker is guessing (×あの人は犯人にほかならない as a deduction). Its very common causal use is the fixed shape 〜からにほかならない, where a whole clause plus から fills the slot, and it belongs to essayistic and formal prose rather than chat.

examples.ruby: 芸術[げいじゅつ]とは作者[さくしゃ]の内面[ないめん]の表現[ひょうげん]にほかならない。
examples.english: Art is nothing other than an expression of its maker's inner life.

examples.ruby: その発言[はつげん]は弱者[じゃくしゃ]に対[たい]する差別[さべつ]にほかならない。
examples.english: That remark is nothing short of discrimination against the vulnerable.

examples.ruby: 今回[こんかい]の受賞[じゅしょう]は皆様[みなさま]のお支[ささ]えのおかげにほかなりません。
examples.english: This award is thanks to your support, and nothing else.
